source.company_summary: Our embedded computing portfolio delivers high-performance, scalable solutions across CPUs, APUs, FPGAs, System-on-Modules (SOMs) and adaptive SoCs for markets such as automotive, industrial, healthcare, storage and networking with integrated AI processing capabilities.
product_stack: adaptive SoCs and accelerated processing units
acceleration cards for the data center

data_center: are based on AMD CDNA™ architecture

ai_exposure.summary: We also offer data center rack-scale platform designs that incorporate AMD data center products to meet the growing performance demands of AI supercomputers and machine learning workloads.

strategy_changes.change: In 2025, we introduced key optimizations and expanded support for frameworks and libraries, improving performance for generative AI workloads and simplifying the developer experience.
In 2025, we launched processors for gaming and content creation with Ryzen 9 9950X3D and Ryzen 9 9900X3D.
In 2025, we launched AMD Ryzen AI 300 Series processors featuring a next generation NPU supporting Microsoft Copilot+ PCs, our latest “Zen 5” architecture and our AMD RDNA™ 3.5 graphics architecture.

In 2025, we launched our Radeon AI PRO R9000 Series of graphics cards, intended for local AI inference and creative workloads enabling professionals to accelerate AI-driven content creation and advanced visualization tasks directly on their workstation.

translation.company_summary: 我們的嵌入式運算產品組合提供高效能、可擴展解決方案，涵蓋 CPUs、APUs、FPGAs、系統模組（SOMs）及適應性 SoCs，應用於汽車、工業、醫療保健、儲存與網路等市場，並具備整合 AI 處理能力。

ai_exposure.summary: 我們亦提供整合 AMD 資料中心產品的機架級資料中心平台設計，以滿足 AI 超級電腦與機器學習工作負載日益增長的效能需求。

strategy_changes.change: 2025 年，我們推出了關鍵優化，擴展對框架及函式庫的支援，提升生成式 AI 工作負載的效能，並簡化開發者體驗。
2025 年，我們推出適用於遊戲與內容創作的 Ryzen 9 9950X3D 與 Ryzen 9 9900X3D 處理器。
2025 年，我們推出 AMD Ryzen AI 300 系列處理器，採用新一代 NPU，支援 Microsoft Copilot+ PCs，搭載最新“Zen 5”架構及 AMD RDNA™ 3.5 顯示晶片架構。
2025 年，我們推出 Radeon AI PRO R9000 系列顯示卡，專為本地 AI 推論與創意工作負載設計，協助專業人士直接在工作站加速 AI 驅動的內容創作與進階視覺化任務。
